That closes the first day. This afternoon you used R on one file, found your way round the IDE, and took apart the report in which the rest of the workshop is written, ending with a render from a clean session. The reading of this session is the module Quarto documents, whose first sections knit small documents in your browser and whose section of tasks, near the end, holds the six tasks that you did today in the IDE workspace, so that you can repeat them at home, and the module Git and GitHub takes the same folder into version control.
